metaDescription: IT and AI for BPOs, hospitality, education, and PCI / SOC 2 companies — senior nearshore delivery on US Eastern hours, from Barranquilla.

hero.title: We speak your industry, not just our stack.
hero.intro: The same five services land differently in a contact center than in a hotel. These are the industries where we already know the terrain — the systems, the pressure points, and what actually pays off first.

cards.title: BPOs & contact centers
cards.body: IT and compliance from founders who run technology for a 24/7 multinational BPO — downtime, client audits, and agent churn handled by people who live them.

cards.title: Hotels & restaurants
cards.body: AI assistants that answer calls and messages in English and Spanish, book and take orders in seconds, and managed IT that keeps service running.

cards.title: Education
cards.body: Managed IT, student-data security, and front-office automation for schools and education companies — senior engineers at rates a school budget can carry.

cards.title: PCI DSS & SOC 2 companies
cards.body: From gap assessment to audit-ready, led by people who have taken both programs end to end — with continuous vulnerability management behind it.

cta.title: Don't see your industry? Tell us about it.
cta.subtitle: A 30-minute call is enough to know whether we understand your operation well enough to help — and we'll say so either way.
